title: Why decentralized identity will replace passwords forever

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if the password — the cornerstone of digital security — is about to become obsolete? Why?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Decentralized identity, using blockchain and self-sovereign ID, already lets users control their own digital identities without centralized login systems.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But who ensures these systems are inclusive? Marginalized groups may lack the digital literacy or access to benefit from them, risking further exclusion.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are creating open-source tools and user-friendly interfaces to lower barriers, and partnering with NGOs to ensure equitable access.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a world where identity is portable, secure, and respected — where no one is locked out of their own life due to a forgotten password.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future is not just about security, but about reclaiming control — one decentralized identity at a time.

video_cue: A person securely logging into a service using a smartphone and a biometric scan, with their identity verified on a decentralized network.
